# Binding Wire Machine

> Premier manufacturer and global exporter of high-speed automatic wire nail making machines, continuous wire drawing lines, and binding wire machinery in Rajkot, Gujarat, India.

## Products & Machinery Catalog
- [Automatic Wire Nail Making Machine](https://www.bindingwiremachine.in/nail-making-machine.html): High-speed automatic nail making machines (models IN1+ to IN6) producing construction nails from 1 to 6 inches at speeds up to 550 pcs/min.
- [Continuous Wire Drawing Machine Plant](https://www.bindingwiremachine.in/wire-draw-machine.html): Continuous multi-pass bull block wire drawing lines (3 to 7 blocks) for MS and HB wire reduction from 5.5mm to 1.2mm with water-cooled drums.
- [Automatic Binding Wire Making Machinery](https://www.bindingwiremachine.in/binding-wire-making-machine.html): Complete turnkey plant setup for manufacturing soft black annealed binding wire with electric pit annealing furnaces.
- [Industrial Machinery Price List](https://www.bindingwiremachine.in/binding-wire-machine-price.html): Factory-direct price list and export CIF quotation guide for buyers in India, Kenya, Germany, Nigeria, UAE, and worldwide.
